visual_review.coverage: All 70 variants inspected in four-angle contacts and 40m silhouette sheets; 11 botanical closeups plus mushroom underside and berry/calyx closeups.
corrections: Joined compound leaves with rachis stems; no floating leaflets.
Rounded shrub crown geometry; adjusted seasonal cluster counts within 300 triangles.
Seeded mushroom patch positions and scales vary between a/b.
Enlarged five-point persistent nightshade calyx; reviewed against bilberry fruit.
botanical_tells: Carrot central dark floret and divided leaves; hemlock spotted stem; water-hemlock broad serrated divided foliage.
Brown field-mushroom underside without cup; white death-cap underside, ring and basal cup.
Ramsons star umbels; lily arching one-sided white bells.
Comfrey short drooping bells and hairy accents; foxglove tall tubular-flower spire.
Low bilberry versus taller nightshade with five-point berry calyx.
limitations: Palette has no purple/pink; woad/madder approximations documented in SOURCES.md.
Tiny herbs deliberately become hard to distinguish at 40m; close-up botanical tells preserved.
Seasonal flowers and fruits coexist in source previews and use separate named meshes for runtime hiding.
